application_conditions: Any platform; no website required. Apply via Impact.com; review about one week; partner handbook after approval.
paid_action: Referring new customers; each commissionable action validated before payment (per-product actions in contract).
validation_conditions: Only Crypto.com-communicated new-customer incentives allowed; other codes may make referrals untrackable.

commission.model_note: 'Up to 50%' revenue share across products plus product bonuses; fixed plan based on referred customers and trading volume; per-product rates only in the contract. Nothing stated for the card specifically.

revenue_share.duration_note: Earnings from a referred customer generally run 180–365 days after KYC completion

rules_note: Cannot be based in or promote to countries where affiliate marketing is prohibited or the app is unavailable (list in contract). Brand bidding and email rules not stated.

evidence.title: Crypto.com Affiliate Program page + FAQ
evidence.excerpt: Earn up to 50% across products; monthly payouts; apply via Impact.com; review ~1 week; earnings window 180–365 days after KYC.

evidence.title: Crypto.com Exchange Affiliate Programme (help centre, 2026-07-20)
evidence.excerpt: Exchange programme: form at crypto.com/exchange/affiliate; needs a 'considerable social presence'; up to 50% of referees' trading fees; paid daily in USDC to the Exchange account; Broker Programme members excluded; the Visa Card is not named as commissionable.

notes: Card-specific commission unknown: revenue share is driven by trading activity, not card orders. Do not count a card order as revenue. 2026-11-04: the Exchange affiliate programme is trading-only and selective; the Impact-based app programme (crypto.com/affiliate) remains the relevant route for the card, card commission still unknown.
